This document lists the 
minor maintenance procedure P1 of emergency diesel engine, which must be, 
performed every 5000-operation hr base as indicated by H 5000 in the title 
block.

The first draft initiated by 
eng. Hesham M. Hassan, reviewed by

eng. Ali Mostafa Al-lithy and 
approved by eng.: Mostafa Alam Head Sector of Talkha steam power station 2 x 
210 MW.

category.

Clean 
 suction and exhaust valves chamber 
 for any
 carbon deposits

Re-machine the 
 exhaust
 valve 
 seats
 on the milling machine and grind them.

Check 
 Suction and exhaust valves springs from any fatigues and renew if any.

Readjust 
 Starting, pressure relief and fuel injecting valve

Clean 
 Water spaces in cylinder heads.

Check 
 Rocker arm pins, bushes and rollers from any mechanical wear and replace if 
 the clearance w.r.t clearance table no. 1 at MPIS doc no. Dsl-009-r0

Check the tightness of all parts 
 according to MPIS # Dsl-009-r0

Check the 
 Piston pins (must fit 
 firmly in piston) from any mechanical wear and replace 
 if the clearance w.r.t clearance table no. 1, 2 at MPIS doc no. Dsl-009-r0

Check the

 rings)

Check the

 bushes,

 from any mechanical wear and replace 
 if the clearance w.r.t clearance table no. 1 at MPIS doc no. Dsl-009-r0

Check 
 for wear and 
 replace 
 if needed w.r.t clearance table no. 1, 2 at MPIS doc no. Dsl-009-r0

Check the Cams (Keying on),
 Lifters, 
 Rollers and lifters pin, Camshaft bearings
 from any mechanical wear and replace 
 if the clearance w.r.t clearance table # 1, 2 at MPIS doc # Dsl-009-r0

Check the Gears,
 Lifters, 
 Pin and inter mediate gear bush 
 from any mechanical wear and replace 
 if the clearance w.r.t clearance table # 1, 2 at MPIS doc no. Dsl-009-r0

Check the 
 valves 
 of starting equipment from any leakage, repair or replace if 
 needed.

Clean the air 
 distributor filter.

Check the 
 governor and regulation parts for any abnormal condition, 
 repair or replace if needed.

Check the 
 alignment and end floats of crankshaft and realignment 
 if needed.

Check the 
 crankshaft, crank pins, and main bearings from any mechanical wear or cracks 
 and replace if the clearance 
 w.r.t clearance table no. 1, 2 at MPIS doc no. Dsl-009-r0

Check the driving 
 wheels,
 gear, bushes, and bearings of shaft of fuel oil pump, for 
 any mechanical wear or cracks and replace 
 if the clearance w.r.t clearance table no. 1, 2 at MPIS doc no. Dsl-009-r0
Readjust the regulating valve.

Check the end floats measuring for wear limits 
 w.r.t clearance table no. 1, 2 at MPIS doc no. Dsl-009-r0

Check the tightness of fuel oil piping and of injecting 
 equipment (Injecting pumps, injecting valves)
Carry out the tightness test mainly of valves and piping)

Visually inspect for seizure, carbon deposits, corrosion, 
 scales, etc

Technical Procedure
Introduction
This document lists the 
minor maintenance procedure P1 of emergency diesel engine, which must be, 
performed every 5000-operation hr base as indicated by H 5000 in the title 
block.
The first draft initiated by 
eng. Hesham M. Hassan, reviewed by 
Maintenance director: eng. Saad Mostafa, revised by eng. Samir Abdel-Gelil at EDEPCo., accepted by maintenance general director: 
eng. Ali Mostafa Al-lithy and 
approved by eng.: Mostafa Alam Head Sector of Talkha steam power station 2 x 
210 MW.
